schema_transition.evidence: Reviewed transition from installed through-012 to through-012-014-010-011-013-015-016, preserving exact-prefix order and hashes. Pending set: [014, 010, 011-rewritten, 013, 015, 016]. Each migration owns BEGIN/COMMIT; its ledger commits atomically. 010 adds metadata-only columns and 18 NOT VALID checks, avoiding an initial 198.5M-row ACCESS EXCLUSIVE scan; validation is separate. Never-applied 011 is one wide archetype row per system; 011/013 create empty relations/indexes. 015 adds audited product publication on PUBLISHED generations, gated Finder views/pointer guards and removes the unsafe generation publisher. 016 installs the append-only purge ledger, NOLOGIN executor and bounded recovery fences; installation invokes no purge, DELETE or VACUUM. Its amendment records an optional exact same-plan integrity FAILED_STOP acknowledgement in WRITER_FENCE_RESTORED. A second amendment, after the 1% purge rehearsal stopped on a state-query timeout, rewrites purge_open_event as one grouped last-closing pass with identical results instead of a per-event anti-join whose cost grew with the square of the batch count. A terminal committed rewrite additionally requires the exact start event, departed recorded backend and clear rewrite/analyze progress; other mutators retain the integrity fence. scripts/operator/v3_schema_identity.py reproduces installed checksum 4cae7d2be2e1909d468b82c6802b265118303cc0fe1c257c2f6c9e963f3a39f5 and target checksum d7efe68932293813b4e5ec569a7b46d48ea660ef3de36b02c913110eedd7c4e6 with migration-set identity sha256:c274b55ca590265e3a111edb608ce7d907f7c7c5fcfad95cdde6e4f5433e95fc. Accepted bed755b9 remains compatible with both endpoints and every intermediate prefix: its ratings reads are unchanged and it calls no purge or derived DELETE. If 014 is applied alone, recut from through-012-014 before further apply. Registration only; exact-head acceptance, reviewed plan and separate apply remain required.
